source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of transcription and the two DNA strands (PDF 133).

blocks.text: Transcription gene expression ka pehla qadam hai jis mein DNA se complementary RNA banta hai. DNA ka sirf aik strand, template strand, transcribe hota hai aur mRNA us ka complementary hai. Doosra strand coding strand hai kyunke us ka silsila mRNA jaisa hai, siwaye is ke ke jahan mRNA mein U hai wahan us mein T.

blocks.title: Maloomat
blocks.text: Template strand ko antisense (-) strand aur coding strand ko sense (+) strand bhi kehte hain.

blocks.prompt: Coding strand ATG GCT hai. Template strand aur mRNA kya hain?
blocks.explanation: Template (3' se 5'): TAC CGA. mRNA: AUG GCU, yaani coding strand jis mein T ki jagah U.

items: Coding (sense) strand = mRNA ka silsila, U ki jagah T.
